news.text: Mega-IPOs could signal market top, say analysts as SpaceX and OpenAI prep record floats
IMAX has held ‘preliminary talks’ with potential buyers, source says
Will Elon Musk eventually merge SpaceX with Tesla? Speculation is building
Traders think this legacy tech stock is the ultimate quantum play
SpaceX, OpenAI valuations would mean they leapfrog Berkshire Hathaway on first day of trading
Oura, smart ring maker, confidentially files for IPO

brief:
◆ Market Overview

Futures pointing to a modest green open with small-caps leading (+0.94% on IWM) and VIX cooling off 3%. Energy getting hammered pre-market while utilities catch a defensive bid. The mega-IPO narrative around SpaceX/OpenAI has analysts calling market top signals - classic late-cycle behavior worth monitoring.

◆ What to Watch

  • Michigan Consumer Sentiment Final - All inflation and sentiment data drops at 2pm, potential market mover given current macro uncertainty
  • Fed Waller Speech - 3pm EST, watch for any hawkish shifts given persistent inflation concerns
  • BJ's Wholesale (BJ) - EPS est $1.059, retail bellwether ahead of Memorial Day weekend
  • IMAX Buyout Talks - Preliminary discussions could spark M&A momentum in entertainment space

◆ Sector Rotation

Utilities leading (+1.10%) with tech close behind (+0.82%) - classic risk-on/risk-off mixed signals. Energy getting crushed (-1.12%) on what looks like profit-taking after recent strength. Consumer staples weak (-1.01%) suggesting rotation out of defensives, but utilities strength contradicts that thesis.
✦ Bull Case
VIX compression (-2.93%) with small-cap leadership suggests risk appetite returning. Mega-IPO pipeline could bring massive liquidity flows into broader market.
⚡ Key Driver
SpaceX/OpenAI IPO speculation dominating headlines. If these deals price successfully, it validates current valuations. If they crater, it's your canary in the coal mine.
⚠ Bear Case
Mega-IPO timing at potential market tops historically signals institutional distribution. Mixed sector rotation suggests indecision, not conviction buying.

◆ Levels That Matter

  • SPY $745 - Resistance level that's been tested multiple times, break above opens $750+ target
  • QQQ $720 - Key psychological level, watch for follow-through if tech continues morning strength
  • VIX 25 - Below this level and we're back in complacency territory
  • XLE $88 - Energy support level being tested hard, break below accelerates selling

Not a prediction. A preparation. Make your plan before the bell.
